subject: Energy
title: International Climate Agreements
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on International Climate Agreements.

hook.text: The Paris Agreement (2015) united 196 nations around a shared goal—limit global warming to well below 2°C.

buildup.text: Each nation sets its own targets (NDCs)—voluntary pledges reviewed every five years to ratchet up ambition.

discovery.text: COP summits convene annually—thousands of negotiators haggling over finance, targets, and fossil fuel language.

twist.text: Current pledges fall short—even if met, they'd lead to about 2.5°C of warming, well above the 1.5°C goal.

climax.text: COP28 (2023) agreed to 'transition away from fossil fuels'—the first time fossil fuels were named in a COP decision.

punchline.text: 196 nations, one target—but pledges still fall short.

quiz.question: What historic first happened at COP28 in 2023?
options: A global carbon tax was agreed
Fossil fuels were named in a COP decision for the first time
All nations adopted the same target
